about.title: We Are Aftos Studio
about.subtitle: An independent game studio born from the passion of creating experiences that leave a mark.
about.missionDesc: At Aftos Studio we believe video games are more than entertainment. They are an art form, a storytelling tool, and a medium to connect people. Our goal is to develop games with their own identity that excite and surprise.
about.visionTitle: Making our mark in the indie industry
about.visionDesc: We aspire to become a benchmark in independent development, proving that with talent, teamwork, and dedication, experiences on par with major studios can be created.
about.value1Desc: We seek fresh and original ideas in every project. Innovation is our driving force.
about.value2Desc: We work as a united team where every voice counts and every idea adds value.
about.value3Desc: We love what we do. Every line of code, every pixel, and every musical note carries our passion.
